With SAP Business Network Supplier mobile app for iPhones, you can collaborate with your customers anywhere and anytime. This app connects to SAP Business Network and allows suppliers to transact and respond to new business leads right from their iPhone. 

Key features of SAP Business Network Supplier for iPhone
• Create documents on the go, such as PO and non-PO invoices, order confirmation, service entry sheets, advanced shipped notices, and credit memos
• Receive real-time notifications for transaction requests that need your attention
• Find transactional documents fast using the search capability powered by S/4HANA
• Improve invoice visibility to understand invoice status, status changes, and historical information
• Share orders and invoices, add comments, and send as PDF attachments in e-mail or text to collaborate

Note: You can use the SAP Business Network Supplier mobile app if your company uses SAP Business Network and has enabled you as a user. See the application license agreement for details.
